author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
They named a game box after me! Much like that wonderful Citadel Colour mustard yellow of yester-year... I'm flattered to be enshrined on the new Mordhei.... ehem... Embergard box. Spearhead! Right. Let's check it out. 

Big thanks to GW for a complimentary copy of the boxto review.
